2608.08048.title: Tools to Explain Neural Networks for Power System Dynamics
2608.08048.paper_summary: This paper presents, for the first time in power systems literature to our knowledge, analytical tools to explain the training performance of machine learning surrogate models for power system dynamics. Power system simulations are increasingly challenged by stiff and multi-timescale dynamics arising from converter-interfaced resources and fast control loops. Machine learning surrogates emerge as promising tools to handle this complexity and accelerate dynamic simulations. However, their performance remains difficult to interpret, which limits their adoption. Building on the small-signal eigenvalue analysis in power systems, this paper uses the Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) method. NTK delivers a modal interpretation of the learning performance, identifying error modes that decay rapidly versus others that converge slowly. This connection explains how physical stiffness and timescale separation in power system dynamic models appear as optimization stiffness during Neural Network (NN) training. Based on this analysis, we develop adaptive loss-weighting strategies to improve and explain why structure-aware neural architectures, such as ActNet, perform better than vanilla NNs. We assess the proposed approach on physics-informed machine learning surrogate models of \acp{SM} and power electronic converters. The methods introduced in this paper can deliver the necessary analytical tools to interpret and improve the performance of machine learning surrogates, paving the way for the systematic, physics-aware design of NN architectures and training strategies. By moving beyond trial-and-error development, these tools reveal training dynamics and failure modes, support more reliable design decisions, and strengthen confidence in machine-learning surrogates for engineering applications.
2608.08048.paper_summary_zh: 這篇論文首次在我們所知的電力系統文獻中提出了分析工具，以解釋機器學習代理模型在電力系統動態中的訓練表現。<lb/>電力系統模擬越來越受到來自轉換器介面的資源和快速控制迴路所產生的剛性和多時間尺度動態的挑戰。<lb/>機器學習代理作為應對這種複雜性並加速動態模擬的有前途的工具而出現。<lb/>然而，它們的表現仍然難以解釋，這限制了它們的採用。<lb/>基於電力系統中的小信號特徵值分析，本文使用神經切線核（NTK）方法。<lb/>NTK提供了學習表現的模態解釋，識別出快速衰減的誤差模式與緩慢收斂的其他模式。<lb/>這種聯繫解釋了在電力系統動態模型中，物理剛性和時間尺度分離是如何在神經網絡（NN）訓練期間表現為優化剛性的。<lb/>基於這一分析，我們開發了自適應損失加權策略，以改善並解釋為什麼結構感知的神經架構，如ActNet，表現優於普通的NN。<lb/>我們在物理知識驅動的機器學習代理模型的\acp{SM}和電力電子轉換器上評估了所提出的方法。<lb/>本文中介紹的方法可以提供必要的分析工具，以解釋和改善機器學習代理的性能，為系統的、物理知識驅動的NN架構和訓練策略的設計鋪平道路。<lb/>通過超越試錯法的開發，這些工具揭示了訓練動態和失敗模式，支持更可靠的設計決策，並增強對工程應用中機器學習代理的信心。
